42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

(1) 7 and 9

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 3**__ × 6 + 7 - 9

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**14 × 6**__ + 7 - 9

⇒ 84 + 7 - 9

⇒ 91 - 9 = 82

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) 3 and 7

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 6 + 9 - 3

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**6 × 6**__ + 9 - 3

⇒ 36 + 9 - 3

⇒ 45 - 3 = 42

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) 6 and 7

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 7 + 9 - 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 14 × 7 + 9 - 6

⇒ 98 + 9 - 6

⇒ 107 - 6 = 101

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) 3 and 6

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 6**__ × 3 + 9 - 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**7 × 3**__ + 9 - 7

⇒ 21 + 9 - 7

⇒ 30 - 7 = **23**

⇒ '42 ÷ 6 × 3 + 9 - 7 = 23'

Here, the equation is** satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is "**3 and 6**".

questions.question: Which of the following monetary instruments of RBI is qualitative in nature?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Moral Suasion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Moral suasion** is a** qualitative monetary instrument** used by the **RBI **to **persuade banks** to act in a certain way without actually mandating them to do so.
 
• It involves using **informal communication** and** persuasion techniques** to influence the** behavior of banks **and other financial institutions.
 
• This instrument is used to maintain** financial stability, regulate credit flow, and ensure compliance **with monetary policy objectives.
 
• **Cash reserve ratio, bank rate, and open market operations **are all quantitative monetary instruments that involve **controlling the supply of money** in the economy through** direct interventions** in the money market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cash reserve ratio** is the percentage of **deposits** that banks are required to keep with the **RBI **as a reserve.
 
• **Bank rate **is the** interest rate** at which the RBI lends to **commercial banks.**
 
• **Open market operations** involve **buying and selling government securities **to control the money supply.
 
• Hence, the** correct answer **is option 1 - Moral suasion.

• These showers are accompanied by **strong winds, lightning, and hailstorms, **and can cause **damage to crops, houses, and electric poles.**

• The **Chief Minister** is the head of the **Council of Ministers** in a state and is responsible for the **administration of the state.**

• The Chief Minister is responsible for the** day-to-day administration** of the state and for** implementing the policies **of the state government.
 
 
 
• The **Prime Minister** is the head of the **Union Council of Ministers** and is responsible for the** overall administration** of the country.
 
 
• However, the Prime Minister** does not have** the power to** proclaim emergency **in India.
 
 
 
• The **President of India** is elected by an** electoral college **consisting of the **elected members **of both **houses of Parliament **and the **elected members of the Legislative Assemblies **of the states.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the one who gets 75% of the votes is elected by a majority of 520 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?

The winner got 75% votes and won by 520 votes.

**Calculation:**

Let the total votes polled be 100x

Votes of winning candidate = 75% of 100x = 75x

⇒ Votes of losing candidate = 100x - 75x = 25x

According to the question,

75x - 25x = 520

⇒ 50x = 520

⇒ x = 10.4

So, total votes polled = 10.4 × 100 = 1040

**∴ The total number of votes polled is 1040.**

**Solution:**

N = (243 + 253 + 263 + 273)

**Concept:**

(a3 + b3) = (a + b)(a2 - ab + b2) and 

(a + b) always divides a3 + b3

**Calculation:**

N = (243 + 253 + 263 + 273)

⇒ N = (243 + 253 + 263 + 273)

By using the above formula

⇒ N = (24 + 27)(24² - 24 × 27 + 27²) + (25 + 26)(25² - 25 × 26 + 26²) 

⇒ N = 51(odd number) + 51(odd number) 

As the sum of two odd numbers is even.

⇒ N = 51 × (even number) 

Now, required remainder 

R = 51 × even number/(51 × 2)

R = even number / 2

**Hence, the remainder will be zero.**
